thread:
anna: Heads up — planning a controlled enable of the feature flag `fast-path-llm` during tonight's change window (23:00-01:00 UTC). Start: 5% -> ramp to 20% over 30m. Model route: v3 (pinned to v3.1 for canary). I'll kick off the release at 23:05 UTC.

anna: Deploy artifacts pushed: rel-2026-09. PR: http://ci/repo/pull/981 (contains FF config + model-route pin).

devon: link received. What are our gating metrics?

maria: p95 latency, error-rate, and tokens/sec. Also cost-per-token for visibility. If p95 > 600ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 5m buckets, we rollback.

anna: Agreed. I'll configure the FF runway and alerts. Starting state: v3 = 5% at t0. Ramp schedule: +15m set v3=12%, +30m set v3=20%. Fallback: v2 route.

anna: FF CLI snippet I'm going to run:
```
redwood ff set fast-path-llm --variant v3=5 --ramp v3:12@15m,v3:20@30m --fallback v2 --pin-version v3.1
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for rel-2026-09 (id: rb-179400). Canary rollout at 5%. Artifacts verified.

jay_oncall: I'll monitor SLO dashboards: /dashboards/llm-routing-slo and /dashboards/fast-path-health. Ping me if alert fires.
\
devon: Can you add these metrics to the temporary release pane? p95_latency, error_rate, tokens_per_second, model_cost_token.

anna: Done — added to release pane and created alert rules. Alert thresholds: p95>550ms (warning), p95>600ms (critical); error_rate>0.2% (warning), >0.5% (critical).

maria: Rollback playbook:
- Critical alert -> run rollback command to 0%
- Pin traffic to v2
- Open incident channel #release-1794000123 (ops will create)

maria: Rollback command (dry):
```
redwood release rollback rel-2026-09 --ff fast-path-llm --set-weight v3=0 --pin-route v2
```

anna: If deploy-bot reports >10% errors in first 10m I'll manually trigger rollback. Also will enable traffic-shed to reduce load if latency spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +6m: p95=422ms, error_rate=0.07%, tokens/s normal. No anomalies.

devon: Good numbers. Schedule for automated ramp at +15m and +30m remains. I'll stand by for any manual cut.

maria: Confirming regional pins: eu-west -> v2 fallback ready, us-east -> v2 fallback ready. Also double-checking model weights are sticky to session_id for 24h.

anna: Affirmative. Session affinity set to 24h in FF config.

deploy-bot: Canary at 5% complete. Next scheduled weight set at +15m.

jay_oncall: Not seeing anomalies in traces. I'll stay on-call for first 45m and then hand off.

anna: Thanks everyone. I'll post short release notes after window with final weights and a link to the perf snapshot. :thumbsup:

anna: Release notes draft (will post at 01:05 UTC):
- Release: rel-2026-09
- Feature: fast-path-llm enabled with gradual rollout (5%->20% over 30m)
- Model pinned: v3.1 canary, fallback v2
- Rollback criteria: p95>600ms or error_rate>0.5% over 3 buckets -> immediate rollback
- Observability: p95, error-rate, tokens/s, cost-per-token tracked

deploy-bot: Final status @ +34m: ramp reached 20% with p95=438ms, error_rate=0.09%. No rollback triggered. Release complete.
